subject: PO notation, spend envelope and line-item correction plan for StratusPay onboarding
content:
From: Lindsey Park <lindsey@stratuspay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <payables@stratuspay.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup: PO numbering scheme, spend cap and line-item mapping

Hi Priyom —

Thanks again — we completed the onboarding form (attached) but our procurement team has a few follow-ups before we can start. Two quick asks: 

1) How do you want the PO number to appear on invoices? We currently issue POs with a 6-digit prefix plus a project suffix (e.g., 460122-STR). We need the official Redwood PO string to appear so our AP system can auto-apply the credit.

2) Our initial budget is split across two cost codes. Can you confirm the spend envelope / cap on the provisional PO? We need the hard cap to be visible in the PO metadata so our system flags any overages.

3) Also, a handful of line items (metering / ingress fees) are being reclassified by our finance team. Any chance Redwood can issue a provisional PO that lists the line items as codeable rows so we can map them locally? Our AP wants the SKU->GL mapping to line up for reconciliation.

Attached: stratuspay_onboarding_form_v2.pdf

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Lindsey

--
Lindsey Park
Head of Finance Ops, StratusPay

-----Original Message-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey@stratuspay.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor setup: PO numbering scheme, spend cap and line-item mapping

Hi Lindsey —

Thanks for the form and the clear asks. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- PO string: We can emit the PO as PO-<vendor>-<6digit> (e.g., PO-STRATUS-460122) in the supplier-facing doc. If StratusPay prefers to keep the internal suffix, we can include both: PO-STRATUS-460122 / 460122-STR as a second identifier field. Which would work best for your AP?

- Spend cap: For onboarding we can provision a provisional PO with a hard spend cap. For your initial activation we recommend setting the provisional cap to $75,000 USD to cover the first 90 days; we can adjust after usage review. Connor will confirm if a tighter cap (e.g., $50k) is required from our side for billing hold policies.

- Line items: We can issue line rows with a free-text SKU label so your team can map to GL codes. To avoid downstream reconciliation drift, please send a simple mapping table (SKU -> GL code) and we'll bake that into the PO metadata and the invoice export.

I've attached a proposed PO mapping workbook; Connor will follow up on the cap and issuance timeline.

Attachments: proposed_po_mapping.xlsx

Thanks —
Priyom
Head of Procurement Partnerships | Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>; Lindsey Park <lindsey@stratuspay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor setup: PO numbering scheme, spend cap and line-item mapping

Lindsey / Priyom —

Looping back after a quick sync with Ops: 

- We can confirm a provisional PO will be created within 48 hours once a signed onboarding form and W-9 (if required) are in our system. That provisional PO will carry a hard cap field (the one visible to your AP). We can set that cap to $50,000 or $75,000 — whichever you prefer. If you need a staged release (ex: $25k to start, then rise to $75k on day 30), we can model that as well but it requires a manual authorization step from Redwood finance.

- PO identifier: To keep our ledger clean, we usually publish the primary PO as: PO-RED-<6digit>. However, to support your auto-apply, we will include an alternate_identifier field equal to your 460122-STR pattern. In practice this means the PDF and EDI payload will show both IDs.

- Line items: We had one internal note — the metering fee should be one line with a unit price (MB per 1k tokens) and a separate line for support/monitoring. If StratusPay wants to reclassify ingress fees into two accounting codes, submit the simple mapping and we'll attach the mapping to the PO.

Action items: 
- Lindsey: confirm preferred cap ($50k | $75k | staged) and attach GL mapping spreadsheet.
- Lindsey: upload signed onboarding form to the Drive link (I've added edit access).
- Priyom/Kim: once form + mapping are present, Ops will create provisional PO and send the issuance PDF + metadata export to payables@stratuspay.com.

Connor O'Brien
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Lindsey Park <lindsey@stratuspay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <payables@stratuspay.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor setup: PO numbering scheme, spend cap and line-item mapping

Thanks all —

We prefer the staged approach: start at $25k for the first 14 days, auto-escalate to $75k on day 30 unless we request a hold. That gives our controllers a chance to reconcile usage. Attached is the GL mapping file (a short table mapping the 3 Redwood SKUs to our GLs). Also uploaded the signed onboarding form to your Drive link.

Attachments: stratuspay_gl_mapping.csv, signed_onboarding_ack.pdf

Lindsey

-----Original Message-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey@stratuspay.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Final: provisional PO issued (PO-RED-983411) + line mapping attached

Lindsey / Finance Ops —

Per the staged cap you requested, we've created a provisional PO. Summary: 

- PO ID (primary): PO-RED-983411
- Alternate ID (vendor): 460122-STR
- Initial cap: $25,000 (effective immediately)
- Auto-escalation: $75,000 on 2026-11-18 unless StratusPay requests a manual hold
- Line items: three rows (Metering / Support / Data egress) with vendor SKUs and your GL mapping attached.

Attachments: provisional_po_PO-RED-983411.pdf, po_line_mapping_export.csv

We're sending the signed issuance PDF and a metadata export to payables@stratuspay.com now. If anything looks off on your end (line totals, GL codes, or the alternate identifier), reply-all and we'll correct within one business day.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Head of Procurement Partnerships | Redwood Inference
